title: Split character function tester
statement: Given a binary subspace $H$ of the cube $�{0,1}^n$ together with a linear decomposition of the cube into $H$ and a complementary factor, this defines a three-query nonadaptive randomized tester with a uniformly sampled seed. On seed $(h,u,v)$, it queries the three points obtained by applying the split's point map to $(u,h)$, $(0,v)$, and $(0,u+v)$, respectively, and accepts according to the split-character transcript predicate.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $n$ specifying the cube dimension
A binary subspace $H$ of the $n$-dimensional binary cube
A binary subspace split giving a complementary factor and linear coordinates
